title: Fixed-coefficient realization of actual strict quotient transitions
statement: Let $W$ be a scheme, $B:\mathbf N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{CommRing}$ a strict tower, and $e_n$ the exact evaluations of the actual system module category into fixed $B_n$-module sheaves [def-pur-etale-system-projection-data]. For $n\le m$ let $q_{m,n}:B_m\to B_n$ be the actual functorial coefficient map, including identity indices. Define transition-evaluation data to be ordinary natural transformations $e_m\to\operatorname{Res}_{q_{m,n}}e_n$ whose values on every local section are exactly those of the actual semilinear strict transition [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. Define its derived transition by termwise cochain application and the universal quasi-isomorphism localization, with the canonical exact-functor composition comparison. Define $t^M_{m,n}: (e_mM)\otimes^L_{B_m}B_n\to e_nM$ as the scalar-extension adjunct of that derived transition under the existing fixed-coefficient extension/restriction adjunction. This is a transport of the actual transitions, not independently chosen derived-level arrows. It is used with the actual system compact-support presentation [def-coef-system-compact-support-data].
